title: fix(service-settings)!: Setup → AI shows no provider until one is configured, and no longer offers or saves Memory
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi94L54atA2yrC9wcfmFS6892)_
Fixes #31960

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Setup → AI & Embedder 的「Provider」不再默认显示「Memory (echo — testing only)」，也不再提供 Memory 选项；没配置时下拉框为空，保存 Memory 会被拒(400),「Test connection」在没选 provider 时直接说「没有配置 AI provider」。
- 为什么改：AI 实际处于禁用状态时，页面却把 Memory 显示成当前 provider,保存 Memory 还弹「Settings saved」,管理员会误以为 AI 已配好，而运行时根本不认 Memory。
- 风险与回滚：收窄四处——保存 Memory 由 200 变 400、`OS_AI_PROVIDER=memory` 被忽略并报错一次、未选 provider 时内置 Test connection 由 200 变 400、未选 provider 时 temperature 等生成参数越界由 200 变 400;provider 改为非必填，Embedder 和日志开关不选 provider 也能单独保存。已选真实 provider(OpenAI 等)的保存、读取、测试完全不变。以前已经存成 memory 的行原样保留、不报错、不锁页面。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/ai.manifest.ts`(provider 下拉的默认值与选项、`aiTestActionHandler` 的未配置分支);`manifests/ai.manifest.test.ts` 末尾的 #31960 用例组。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run src/manifests/ai.manifest.test.ts`,应见 38 个用例全绿，末尾 10 个是本卡新增。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/ai.manifest.ts`:

- The `provider` select declares no `default` and no `memory` option. An unset provider now reads `{ value: null, source: 'default' }`, and the page's select is empty until a provider is chosen.
- `provider` is no longer `required`. Unset is now a served state (a provider may come from boot environment variables), and the console's pre-save check blocks every save on the page while a visible required key reads empty, so a required unset provider would keep the Embedder and Observability sections from saving on their own. In a save, `provider: null` clears it to unset, and `provider: ''` (refused `required` on `main`) is stored as an empty value that the page and Test connection read as not configured. No `ui/**` change.
- `memory` leaves the option table, so the existing save-door option check refuses `PUT /api/settings/ai` `{ provider: 'memory' }` with `400 SETTINGS_VALIDATION` / `invalid_option`, and the existing env judgement reports `OS_AI_PROVIDER=memory` as IGNORED (the key resolves from the next layer). No new refusal code, error code or key.
- The built-in `ai/test` handler (in force when no AI runtime replaces it) no longer reads an absent provider as `memory`: with no provider it answers `ok: false`, severity `warning`, "No AI provider is configured…", the same answer shape `ai/test_embedder` gives for `none`. Its memory branch is gone.
- The six `${data.provider !== 'memory'}` visibility predicates on the generation-default and conversation-title fields go with the option (those fields always show; generation defaults also apply to a provider configured by boot environment variables), and `title_max_length` keeps only its `title_generation_enabled` term. Consequence, declared as a narrowing: with no provider (or `memory`) stored, `temperature`, `max_tokens`, `request_timeout_ms` and `title_max_length` were hidden and so not validated, and an out-of-window value saved 200; they are now visible, so it answers `400 SETTINGS_VALIDATION` (`min_value` / `max_value`), as for any other provider.
- The group description drops its Memory sentence ("Choose the LLM backend.").

`packages/services/service-settings/src/translations/*.ts` (11 locales): the `ai.provider` `memory` option label is removed and the group description is cut to its first sentence, matching the manifest. The knowledge store's own `memory` option labels are untouched.

`content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx`: the paragraph that said the manifest default `provider=memory` is ignored and that `OS_AI_PROVIDER=memory` switches the runtime to memory now says the setting has no default and that `memory` is not a Settings value.

Whether AI is disabled is not derived here: that decision belongs to the AI runtime (see **Carried to repo:cloud**).

## Carried to repo:cloud

The boot decision "No LLM provider configured … AI is DISABLED", the chat refusal "AI is not configured for this environment" and the live Test connection all live in `@objectstack/service-ai`, which this repository does not contain (`PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS.ai.edition: 'cloud'`). The card's "the page states that AI is disabled" half is carried there, per the seat's step-0 ruling (route A):

- `service-ai` calls `settings.registerLiveStatus('ai', …)` from its own decision, so Setup → AI states at the top of the page that AI is disabled (or which provider is live). The seam already exists in `@objectstack/service-settings` and the console already renders its `live_status` banner; plugin-email's `mail` status is the precedent. No spec change and no new `IAIService` member.
- `service-ai` reads a stored (or env-locked) `ai.provider` of `memory`, and a stored empty `ai.provider` (`''`, which Settings now stores rather than refuses), as unset. `content/docs/releases/v9.mdx` records that it treats one as an explicit override today; after this change such a row is still served as stored, while Settings no longer offers or accepts `memory`. (Stating it in the live status is the alternative.)
- Optionally, a write predicate on `ai.provider` (`registerWritePredicate`) for any value the runtime does not honour.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` at the end of `packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/ai.manifest.test.ts`, "no provider is presented until one is configured (#31960)":

- the provider select declares no default and offers no `memory` (raw manifest and after `SettingsManifestSchema.parse`). RED on main.
- an unset provider reads `null` from the `default` rung, unlocked. RED on main.
- save door: `{ provider: 'memory' }` is refused `SETTINGS_VALIDATION` / `invalid_option` at `provider`, and nothing is stored. RED on main.
- env door: `OS_AI_PROVIDER=memory` is ignored with one IGNORED error line; the provider stays unset. RED on main.
- a memory row stored before the option left the table (written under the old table, then the narrowed manifest re-registered, the `mail.provider` / `sendgrid` precedent) is served as stored (`'memory'`, source `global`), `getMany` does not throw, an unrelated key still saves, re-writing memory is refused, a real provider replaces it, and a reset clears it to `null`. RED on main (main still saves the re-written memory).
- CONTROL: a real provider (`openai` with its key) saves and reads as before.
- Test connection with no provider (`{}`, `null`, `''`) answers `ok: false`, `warning`, with no memory/echo wording. RED on main.
- review round 1 (F1): `provider` is not required (raw and parsed), and with nothing stored an embedder-only save, a `trace_enabled` save and a `temperature` save resolve. RED on 16b7b39e.
- review round 1 (F1): in a save, `provider: null` clears to unset (`null`, source `default`), and `provider: ''` is stored and the Test connection stub reads it as not configured. RED on 16b7b39e (refused `required`).
- review round 1 (F2): with no provider, `temperature: 5` is refused `max_value` (window 0–2) and nothing is stored. Green on 16b7b39e; RED under ablation E below (the field hidden while no provider is stored, as on `main`).

Forced test edits, named:

- `ai.manifest.test.ts` › "exposes provider select with … presets": `memory` left the expected option list and `default` is now asserted undefined.
- `ai.manifest.test.ts` › "returns warning for memory provider" pinned the removed memory branch; rewritten as "no longer answers memory as a provider (#31960)": `{ provider: 'memory' }` fails like any provider with no key.
- `ai.manifest.test.ts` › temperature write-door comment no longer cites the memory default (assertions unchanged).
- `settings-service.test.ts` › "does not validate fields hidden for the selected provider" saved `memory`; it now saves `gateway` with its model, which leaves `openai_api_key` hidden the same way.
- `settings-visibility-declaration.pin.test.ts` › the bundled-predicate tripwire moves 96 → 90 (the six removed predicates), with the reason in the comment.

## Acceptance notes

- First-party census of a memory AI provider (seat condition a), on `origin/main` c9246279: no example, docker/compose file, dogfood or qa fixture sets `OS_AI_PROVIDER=memory` or saves `provider: 'memory'`. Hits were the two service-settings tests above (edited), the 11 locale labels (removed) and `environment-variables.mdx` (corrected). `packages/cli/test/dev-start-shared-data-key.integration.test.ts` saves only `openai_api_key` and never touches `provider`; its save is judged the same before and after (the key is hidden unless the provider is `openai`).
- A stored memory row (seat condition b) takes the existing path for a stored value outside a narrowed option table: it is served as stored and never throws, and it locks nothing (pinned above). No read-side rule rewrites it to `null`; that would change how every namespace serves stored values.
- `environment-variables.mdx` still lists `MemoryLLMAdapter` echo mode as the AI runtime's last boot fallback. That is the cloud runtime's boot order, which this repository cannot measure; left as is.

## Verification

Head `2df34556` (`2df34556b571e929355de10f21f0e4342e16d756`), review round 1 (contract review 6755098882, F1–F3). Merge base `c9246279`; `origin/main` gained two commits since (`#31993` runtime, `#31995` cloud-connection), neither touching this diff's files, so not merged.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings test && pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings typecheck`: `Test Files 75 passed (75)`, `Tests 1441 passed (1441)`, typecheck clean; `os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/services/service-settings`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on this head: 92 derived families, all exit 0; `--ran`: `92 derived, 92 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. (The sweep was interrupted by a worker restart after 75 families, all green; the remaining 17 were run on the same head.)
- Full dogfood battery on this head (`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`): `os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0`, `Test Files 445 passed | 3 skipped (448)`, `Tests 3689 passed | 42 skipped (3731)`, no failures.
- Round 0 (head `16b7b39e`): same package suite at 1438/1438, gates 92/92, dogfood 445 files / 3689 tests green.

<details><summary>Red on main (the new pins at 3dfe810c, before the fix)</summary>

```
× declares no provider default and does not offer memory
× an unset provider reads as null from the default rung          expected 'memory' to be null
× save door: memory is refused …                                  promise resolved "{ provider: { value: 'memory', … } }" instead of rejecting
× env door: OS_AI_PROVIDER=memory is loudly ignored …             expected 'memory' to be null
× a memory row stored before the option left the table …          promise resolved instead of rejecting (re-writing memory)
× Test connection with no provider answers that none is configured  expected true to be false
Tests  6 failed | 29 passed (35)
```
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; the tests import src, so no dist leg)</summary>

- A, `memory` back in the option table: 4 red (no-memory declaration, save door, env door, stored row), 4 green. Restored: `blob == HEAD (34c40a9ca902)`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- B, `default: 'openai'` back on `provider`: 5 red (declaration, unset read, save door, env door, stored row). Restored, same proof.
- C, the no-provider branch of `aiTestActionHandler` disabled: 1 red (Test connection with no provider). Restored, same proof.
- D (round 1), `required: true` back on `provider`: 2 red (not-required save pin, empty-provider pin), 9 green. Restored, `blob == HEAD (a4388dcce9e4)`.
- E (round 1), `temperature` hidden while no provider is stored (`visible: "${data.provider != null}"`, the main-era skip): 1 red (the window pin), 10 green. Restored, same proof. A first E attempt used a predicate the evaluator cannot parse (`undefined` identifier); it failed seven pins for that reason, so it is not counted.
- A and B first ran with an anchor that their replacement still contained; the tool refused both (`anchor count moved 1 -> 1`) and restored. Those were no-ops, then re-run with a non-prefix anchor as above.
</details>
